summary.bn: ঝালাই ছাড়া সার্কিট বানানোর বোর্ড। এক সার্কিটে চারটা পর্যন্ত, যেখানে খুশি সরানো যায়।
summary.en: A board for building circuits without soldering. Up to four in a circuit, each moved wherever it is wanted.

simplified: Strips are perfect conductors; no worn contacts.
Each power rail is joined along its whole length. On some full-size boards the rails are split in the middle; check yours with a meter.
Two breadboards never touch electrically, even placed side by side: only a wire joins them. A part's legs all sit on one breadboard.
A breadboard moves a whole hole at a time, so the holes of every board line up.

variants.name: Half: 400 tie points (30 columns, four rails)
Full: 830 tie points (63 columns, four rails)
Mini: 170 tie points (17 columns, no rails)
